newsitem.title: UK: "Large fire" at UK Treasury, fire brigade.
newsitem.headline: "Large fire" at UK Treasury, fire brigade.

text.p: The London Fire Brigade reported a "large fire" at the British treasury building on Tuesday.

A spokesman told Reuters there was "severe smoke logging" in a basement at the building in central London. He said six fire engines were tackling the blaze. There were no immediate reports of any injuries and the extent of the fire was not known.
The ambulance service said it had not been called to the fire.
Eyewitnesses said staff at the building had been evacuated into an area near St James's Park and visitors were not being allowed entry.
A fire officer at the scene described the fire as a "major incident" although one eyewitness said he could not see any smoke or flames.
